messages.author: a4cf6621f03215e3
messages.subject: Recycle solarized accent colors
parts:
Aloha all,

I'm trying to recycle solarized accent colors because I have a few more data points than scale_colour_solarized will plot.  With scale_colour_solarized there are 8 nicely colored symbols and a few blank spaces where symbols should appear.

I'm trying this:

accents <- ggthemes_data$solarized$accent[rep(1:8,times=2)]
p <- ggplot(x, aes(x=date, y=(high + low)/2, colour=Source))
p <- p + scale_colour_manual(values=accents)

but I don't get any symbols.  What am I doing wrong?

All the best,
Tom

accents
